To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
resource efficiency is not only a question of technical solutions but that the human factor plays a major role as well.
the success of resource efficiency innovations is based on a specific culture of mutual trust and the ability of the management to communicate.
resource efficiency and innovation processes are closely linked to a culture of trust.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: Which cultural characteristics of an organisation are relevant for the success of resource efficiency innovations?

a new approach to resource efficiency, which is based on the assumption that a specific culture of innovation and trust is an important prerequisite for the success of resource efficiency innovations in SMEs.
a cultural approach to the implementation of resource-efficient innovations in SMEs, which is to be developed and tested in a practice-oriented way.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the project "Resource Culture" will be able to provide a better understanding of the cultural conditions of resource efficiency innovations.

a culture of trust in enterprises is a decisive success factor for innovation processes, and that the implementation of resource efficient innovations is a good opportunity to develop a culture of trust.

the project "Resource Culture" is going to contribute to a better understanding of the interrelations between resource efficiency, culture, innovation and workplace training and will offer important indications for the design and the improvement of management and qualification instruments for workplace training.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
resource efficiency innovations in SMEs are possible, and that a culture of trust can be identified as a success factor for the implementation of resource efficient innovations.
the promotion of a specific culture of resource efficiency and trust is a key factor for the successful implementation of resource efficiency in SMEs.
the concept of workplace training for resource efficiency innovations is a very promising one, but it needs further development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a culture of trust is a crucial success factor for the implementation of resource efficient innovation.
resource efficiency innovations are not just technical but also organisational and cultural issues.
the promotion of innovation in SMEs requires the integration of a holistic approach that considers the human factor and the organisational context.
